title: Task start request
description: POST /api/v1/tasks/<id>/start (FR-3.2, P3-S03). The agent has written and flushed the started record for this task in its ledger (P3-A02) and asks whether it may run it. It runs the task only after a 200 response with run: true. Repeating the request is safe. The host is the credential's host, never a field in the body; a task of another host, or an unknown id, is 404 not_found.

schema_version.description: Payload schema version. This directory is version 1.

started_at.description: When the agent recorded the task as started (agent clock), RFC 3339 UTC. Stored apart from the server's own times, for display only.
